pipeline_params.description: Dalpha LLM Router -- routes each query across a 4-model pool (gemini-3.8-flash at thinking_level=low, gemini-3-flash-preview with thinking off, gpt-6-luna at reasoning_effort=high, claude-haiku-5.5) using a zero-shot query classifier and a routing table calibrated on external data only. No RouterArena data was used to build or tune the router.
